name: Right-Wing Populism
summary: Right-wing populism combines populism, which pits a pure people against a corrupt elite, with nativism, social conservatism and economic nationalism. It stresses national culture and borders, opposes mass immigration, globalisation and supranational bodies, and favours law and order and a strong leader who expresses the popular will. Economically it is mixed, often protectionist and supportive of welfare for those it deems deserving.
scope: The mainstream national-populist or populist radical right family today, using Mudde and Rovira Kaltwasser's ideational approach, Trump's 2017 inaugural address and Orbán's 2014 Tusnádfürdő speech as examples. Libertarian populists such as parts of the Tea Party are noted but not followed. Left-wing populism and historical agrarian populism are excluded. Because it is a thin ideology, many economic answers are low confidence.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Welfare chauvinism backs state benefits for those deemed deserving, while fiscal-conservative strands resist; parties split.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Wage policy is not a defining issue; working-class appeals coexist with fiscal conservatism. Inferred.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Economic nationalism and fiscal conservatism coexist, so adherents are split on markets versus state direction.

public-ownership.rationale: Some parties favour state control of strategic sectors, others privatisation; no common line. Inferred.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Fiscal conservatism is common to the family and higher taxes on the wealthy are not a theme. Inferred.

unions-good.rationale: Appeals to workers sit alongside hostility to organised labour in some strands. Inferred.

property-fundamental.rationale: Fiscal conservatism and protection of national assets imply support for property rights; not central. Inferred.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Hostility to global capital is matched by fiscal-conservative deregulation; Orbán targets foreign owners specifically.

cut-welfare.rationale: Welfare is kept for the deserving and tied to work ("off of welfare and back to work"), but not simply cut; strands differ.

worker-ownership.rationale: Not part of the programme; economic nationalism and fiscal conservatism point away from it. Inferred.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Law-and-order and security preferences suggest acceptance of surveillance against terrorism. Inferred.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Drugs are framed as a driver of crime and social decay in the Trump address; law-and-order stance.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: Adherents typically see such limits as elite censorship of "the people". Inferred.

strong-leader.rationale: Right-wing populists may concentrate executive power and favour leaders who embody the people over gridlock.

state-harmful.rationale: Mainstream strands want a strong state to defend the nation; only a libertarian fringe holds this.

limit-guns.rationale: Law-and-order populists, especially in the US, usually resist gun limits; varies by country. Inferred.

empower-police-military.rationale: Law and order and a stronger military are central; the Trump address promises protection by the military and law enforcement.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Social conservatism points against legalisation. Inferred.

decide-locally.rationale: Some strands favour federalism, but governments such as Orbán's centralise; split.

rehabilitation.rationale: Emphasis on law and order and punishing crime over rehabilitation.

traditional-family.rationale: Social conservatism and defence of traditional gender roles and family are core, as in Orbán's family-centred policy.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Social conservatism and anti-gender campaigns make most adherents opposed, though some Western parties accept it.

abortion-legal.rationale: Social conservatism and religion lean against, though some Western parties are neutral. Inferred.

more-religion-public.rationale: Orbán ties the order to Christianity and the family is religiously framed; religion is used as a marker of identity.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Seen as favouring minorities over the native population; opposed as identity politics.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Anti-gender movements are a documented feature of the family.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Defending national culture and identity is the core of the ideology.

gradual-change.rationale: Anti-establishment rhetoric and restorationism pull against it, while conservatism favours it. Inferred.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Opposition to immigration is central and nativism is the defining core per scholars.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Euroscepticism and anti-globalism; national sovereignty over supranational bodies.

free-trade.rationale: Protectionism and anti-globalisation are documented; Trump says foreign industry was enriched at American expense.

nation-first.rationale: "Only America First"; every decision on trade, immigration and foreign affairs serves the nation.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Trump criticises defending other nations; the nation's interests come first.

open-borders.rationale: Border protection and nativism rule it out explicitly.

limit-growth.rationale: Economic nationalism prizes jobs and growth; anti-environmentalism is noted.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Associated with anti-environmentalism in the West; economic costs prioritised.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Energy independence and pro-industry stance suggest support; not documented.

revolution-justified.rationale: Claims to work through electoral channels as the voice of the people. Inferred.

experts-over-public.rationale: Opposition to elites and the claim that politics expresses the people's general will.

central-planning.rationale: Economic nationalism and fiscal conservatism are not planned-economy positions.

socialized-markets.rationale: Not a theme; worker or public ownership is alien to the family. Inferred.

land-value-tax.rationale: Not a theme in the family. Inferred.

basic-income.rationale: Welfare is tied to work and desert, so unconditional income conflicts. Inferred from welfare chauvinism.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: "Protection will lead to great prosperity and strength"; protectionism is documented.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Orbán wants the state to make the nation competitive; strands vary. Inferred.

widespread-small-property.rationale: Orbán protects families and national assets from debt and foreign owners, but there is no common stance.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Anti-central-bank views appear in the libertarian strand only.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: Not a theme of the family. Inferred.

one-party-rule.rationale: They claim to win elections as the voice of the people, not to abolish pluralism, though critics note risks.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: No monarchist programme; indifferent to hostile. Inferred.

democracy-best.rationale: Orbán says democracy need not be liberal; adherents claim popular will but may reject limits. Inferred.

direct-votes.rationale: Politics as expression of the people's general will favours referendums over representatives.

right-to-secede.rationale: Nation-state integrity is prized, though some regionalist parties differ. Inferred.

natural-rulers.rationale: Populism holds the common people are the legitimate sovereign against elites. Inferred.

political-violence-never.rationale: Mainstream parties work electorally and condemn violence. Inferred.

war-builds-character.rationale: Not a documented theme; mainstream parties avoid it. Inferred.

separate-church-state.rationale: Orbán ties the order to Christianity; some Western parties are secular.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: Christian identity is invoked, but law is not derived from scripture.

military-superiority.rationale: The Trump address condemns the depletion of the military and promises strength.

ethnic-nation.rationale: Nativism and an ethnic definition of the people are documented; Orbán refers to the ethnic foundation of nation states.

class-struggle-history.rationale: Replaces class conflict with people versus elite and nation versus outsiders.

equal-outcomes.rationale: Rejects egalitarian redistribution in favour of desert and work.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Seen as limiting national sovereignty. Inferred.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Nation-first stance opposes foreign obligations. Inferred.

civilizational-union.rationale: Civilisational framing exists, but nationalism opposes supranational union.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Not addressed; nation's interest is moral, individual self-interest is not endorsed.

duties-before-rights.rationale: Orbán says the nation is not a mere cluster of individuals and ties personal interests to the community.

limit-population.rationale: Pro-natalist family policies are common. Inferred.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: Grievance is deindustrialisation, not industry itself. Inferred.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Defensive of established institutions and jobs. Inferred.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Politics as the people's will conflicts with algorithmic rule. Inferred.

restore-past-order.rationale: Appeals to restoring a lost greatness and order; sometimes progress is also claimed.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Populists often present themselves as pragmatic outsiders; thin ideology.

direct-action.rationale: Work through elections and mass mobilisation. Inferred.

means-match-ends.rationale: The family has no stated view on this; inferred as indifferent.

distribute-by-need.rationale: Welfare is tied to work and desert; Orbán wants a work-based society.

production-for-use.rationale: Not a theme; economic nationalism sits within markets. Inferred.

profit-exploitation.rationale: Marxian analysis is not part of the ideology.

taxation-theft.rationale: Only the libertarian strand holds it.

harm-principle.rationale: Social conservatives accept restrictions beyond harm. Inferred.

individual-rights-only.rationale: Nation and community are treated as more than individuals.

exit-over-voice.rationale: Voting and national belonging are valued. Inferred.

state-as-business.rationale: Some populists are businesspeople, but no stated doctrine. Inferred.

media-academia-power.rationale: Hostility to media and academic elites is documented; whether they hold more power than officials is often asserted.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Mainstream parties disown it, though fringe elements differ. Inferred.

organic-representation.rationale: Party-based electoral politics is the norm. Inferred.

total-state.rationale: Not totalitarian; fiscal conservatism and nationalism.

national-rebirth.rationale: The Trump address describes carnage and decline and promises to restore the nation.

territorial-expansion.rationale: Nation-first rather than expansionist; Trump promises seeking goodwill and the right of all nations to put their own interests first.

universal-morality.rationale: No common stance; adherents hold both universalist and relativist positions.

single-common-good.rationale: The general will of a unified people implies one common good.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Many right populists back Israel; antisemitic fringes differ. Inferred.

diaspora-return-right.rationale: Orbán's ethnic nation concept supports ties to diaspora; others differ.

school-vouchers.rationale: No common position; libertarian strands favour it, others do not.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Fiscal conservatism coexists with populist spending promises.

economic-freedom.rationale: Libertarian strand agrees; economic nationalists do not.

rule-by-example.rationale: The family has no stated view; inferred as indifferent.

national-self-determination.rationale: "It is the right of all nations to put their own interests first"; sovereignty is central.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Religion and emotion feature in identity politics. Inferred.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Welfare chauvinism, expanding welfare only for those deemed fit to receive it, is a documented feature of the family.

positive-liberty.rationale: Welfare chauvinism favours material support for the deserving while fiscal-conservative strands stress freedom from state interference; adherents split.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Orbán's 'work-based society' and the family's welfare chauvinism favour benefits tied to work for those deemed deserving.

class-collaboration.rationale: Populism frames the divide as people versus elite and treats the nation as one community, not as opposed classes.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: The family defends national culture, tradition and heritage against change, so sweeping away inherited institutions runs against its nativism and social conservatism.

dominated-front.rationale: Inferred from its sovereigntist nationalism, which favours bilateral national deals over blocs; some strands resent Western or EU domination, so this is contested.

workers-nation.rationale: Nativism and economic nationalism put the nation ahead of class, as in 'America First' appeals to workers as citizens.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Social conservatism and traditional family values are common, but most mainstream parties do not seek laws assigning public roles by sex; adherents split.

ban-interest.rationale: Not a theme of the family; inferred from its acceptance of capitalist finance, with attacks aimed at foreign banks and owners rather than interest itself.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Inferred: the family's nativism is cultural and civic and aims at borders and immigration, not legally enforced racial classification of its own citizens.

state-class-instrument.rationale: Populists say the establishment has captured the state for its own benefit, but they want to use the state for the people rather than see it as inherently a ruling-class tool.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Populist right parties generally back domestic energy production for jobs and cheap supply; inferred, not a defining issue.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Nativism and the stress on national culture and community lead adherents to expect newcomers to adopt the host culture.

elite-replacement.rationale: The replacement claim is voiced by fringe and some prominent figures but is not accepted by the mainstream of the family; adherents are split.

proportional-representation.rationale: Electoral rules are not a defining issue; parties favour whatever rule suits them and often stress majority rule.

national-mission.rationale: America First and national sovereignty stress putting one's own nation first, rather than imposing its system on others.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Social conservatism leads adherents to deny systematic male advantage; inferred from the family's stance on gender issues.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: The people-versus-establishment divide is the core of populism, which portrays the political class as self-serving and detached.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Inferred from the social conservatism and individual-liberty strand; coercive population policy is not part of the mainstream programme.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Law-and-order and pro-police stances lead adherents to resist prosecuting security forces for past conduct; inferred.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Economic nationalism and welfare for the deserving mean most adherents want a state wider than defence, courts and property.

discourage-race-mixing.rationale: Mainstream national populists usually avoid explicit racial doctrine but stress cultural homogeneity; they would not endorse the statement as worded.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Parties formally affirm equal rights for citizens, but welfare chauvinism and nativism favour distinctions between native and non-native, so support is soft.

socialism-one-country.rationale: Opposes socialism as an elite or internationalist project; inferred, as the issue is outside its agenda.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Tends to reject decolonial and national-guilt framings of settler history; inferred from its nationalism.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: European populists commonly demand one law for all, aimed at Islamic family law and parallel courts; inferred from that stance.

restrict-conversion.rationale: Western populists mostly defend religious freedom for citizens, even while targeting Islam; restrictions on conversion are not a standard demand.

ban-cattle-slaughter.rationale: Not a platform item in the Western populist right; it is a Hindu-nationalist issue, so mainstream adherents here do not back it.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Orbán frames politics around Christian national culture, so removal of religion from state schools is not favoured; inferred.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: Irrelevant to its agenda; it opposes socialism rather than defending a socialist state.

consent-of-governed.rationale: Populism's core claim is that politics should express the general will of the people, which fits a consent-based view of authority, though illiberal strands weaken it.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: Right-wing populists distrust establishment experts as serving elite interests, consistent with this audit's answer on knowledge-power.

trade-surplus.rationale: Economic nationalism and protectionism, as in America First, favour exports and domestic production over imports.

population-transfer.rationale: Mainstream national populists favour curbing immigration and deportation of illegal migrants, but not forced removal of citizen minorities; inferred.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: Populists commonly support strong state force for borders and order, so an absolute prohibition is not their position; inferred.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Nationalist framing of nations competing for strength and a mix of economic nationalism suggest agreement with competition; inferred.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: Adherents are split: some back banning radical parties while populists often decry such bans when used against them; inferred.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Populism opposes arbitrary elite power but has no developed theory of freedom as non-domination; adherents are split.

separated-powers.rationale: Populists treat the people's will as one and distrust checks such as courts and the media; Orbán's illiberal state rejects liberal limits.

vanguard-party.rationale: Populism rejects a vanguard elite in principle, claiming the people's own will, though it favours strong leaders; inferred.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Welfare chauvinism prioritises deserving nationals and workers, not the poor as such; inferred.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: Right-wing populists often court homeowners and the working-class vote with home ownership; parties are split, so inferred.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Right-wing populists in power have generally been indifferent or hostile to strong unions; inferred, with some welfare-oriented exceptions.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Populists blame elites, globalisation and open borders more than population growth itself; inferred.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: Nativism holds that a state should be inhabited by the native group, and non-native elements threaten it.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Populists favour elections as the means of expressing the popular will; sortition is not part of the family.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Populists in power invoke security threats to justify extraordinary measures, and Orbán's illiberal state sets national interest above liberal constraints; inferred.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Economic nationalism and protecting 'the people' from elites sometimes means price caps, as with Orbán's food price ceilings; inferred, and liberal-market strands disagree.

party-controls-media.rationale: Populists attack the mainstream media as elite, yet many defend free speech; parties differ on state control, so this is split.

party-commands-army.rationale: Populist leaders stress the state and nation, not a party, as commander of the armed forces; inferred.

long-naturalization-wait.rationale: Nativism and a restrictive immigration stance imply tighter conditions on citizenship, including long residence.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: Anti-elite appeals favour officials who live like ordinary people, though the ideology has no fixed rule on pay; inferred from the people-versus-elite core.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: Parties are often built around one leader, but populists also attack party machines; adherents are split and the issue is not addressed.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Euroscepticism and rejection of supranational bodies are documented features; Trump and Orban both defend national sovereignty.

head-commands-forces.rationale: A strong leader who expresses the popular will is part of the family; inferred for command of forces and ministers.

church-by-bishops.rationale: Church governance is not a populist concern; inferred as neutral.

clerical-rule.rationale: Right-wing populists invoke Christian values but keep elected secular government; inferred from Orban speech.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Nationalism and putting the nation first make working for one's own government's defeat contrary to the position; Trump stresses total allegiance to the country.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: Social conservatives favour some cultural restriction while populists also defend free speech against elites; split.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Voters, as the people, should decide how long a leader serves; inferred from popular-will rhetoric and long tenures such as Orban's.

recall-officials.rationale: Direct popular control over officials fits the general-will idea; inferred.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Trump demands allies pay more and puts 'America First', but national populists mostly want to renegotiate alliances, not end them; inferred.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Not a populist-right issue; its property-owning, pro-family stance makes abolishing renting unlikely. Inferred.

people-in-arms.rationale: Its inaugural rhetoric stresses rebuilding a strong professional military and backing police and law and order, not replacing them.

rural-life-healthier.rationale: Its imagery of the heartland and 'real' ordinary people against metropolitan elites implies a more wholesome countryside; inferred, not a formal tenet.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: Orban's speech treats the Hungarian nation as one community spanning borders, and nativists favour national unity; inferred for divided nations.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: Populism sets the 'pure people' against an out-of-touch elite, which in practice includes universities and credentialed classes.

cultures-equal-different.rationale: National populists defend their own national or Christian civilisation as worth preserving against multiculturalism rather than treating all cultures as equal.

death-penalty.rationale: Law-and-order populists generally back harsh punishment, including capital punishment for terrorism, though European parties vary.

sex-ed-in-schools.rationale: Social conservatism treats sex and gender teaching as the family's domain and often opposes 'gender ideology' in schools.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: US-style populists often back creationism in schools while European ones rarely raise it; adherents are genuinely split.

restrict-pornography.rationale: Social conservatism and appeals to Christian values lead most adherents to favour legal limits on pornography; inferred.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Nativism ties citizenship to national belonging and ancestry, so descent over mere birth on the soil fits; inferred.

minority-language-support.rationale: Nativism and stress on one national culture make state support for minority languages unattractive; inferred.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Believers in a Christian national culture tend to resist special accommodations for minority faiths such as Islam; inferred.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: Traditionalism and attachment to national custom run against celebrating eccentric ways of living; inferred.

sovereign-debt-cancellation.rationale: Populists favour national sovereignty and distrust global finance but oppose foreign aid; cancellation is an inferred rejection.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Economic nationalists value both sovereignty and national control of the economy; adherents are split on property transformation. Inferred.

constituent-assembly.rationale: Populists claim to express the popular will and have rewritten constitutions, as Orban did; inferred and varies by movement.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: Orban endorsed illiberal democracy, but most populists present themselves as democrats; adherents are split.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: America First puts national interest first and rejects spending on foreign nations at citizens' expense.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Sovereignty and nationalism favour self-reliance in defence; inferred from America First.

direct-election-head-of-state.rationale: Populists favour direct links between the leader and the people over elite-managed institutions. Inferred.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Populists attack unaccountable elites and have pressed central banks; Orban and Trump both challenged them. Inferred.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: National-populists treat the homeland as inalienable and put national interest first; inferred.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: Property is not a defining issue; welfare chauvinism and economic nationalism coexist with pro-owner views. Inferred.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Right populists are anti-communist and regard the USSR as socialist; inferred.

precautionary-principle.rationale: Populists often attack environmental regulation as an elite project that burdens ordinary people; inferred.

collective-defense.rationale: America First rhetoric makes alliance support conditional on burden-sharing, while other parties back NATO; adherents split.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: National-populist parties split on cases such as Crimea, from condemnation to acceptance; inferred.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: The family defends Christian values and national culture and opposes curbing churches.

nonpartisan-head-of-state.rationale: Populists want a leader who embodies one popular will against the elite rather than a neutral figure above politics; inferred.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: The nation as a unified community makes separatism illegitimate, though adherents differ where regional parties are populist; inferred.

region-keeps-system.rationale: Nativist emphasis on one national community and sovereignty cuts against special regional systems; inferred.

sacred-ruler.rationale: Populist leaders claim to speak for the people, not divine descent, though some invoke Christian legitimation; inferred.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Libertarian-leaning populists favour flat taxes while welfare-minded ones do not; parties split.

character-from-environment.rationale: Not a defining issue; nativist and social-conservative strands lean toward innate or cultural character while others do not; split.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: Populists claim the people's will over institutional limits, but still frame rule as lawful; inferred from the illiberal-democracy rhetoric.

space-expansion.rationale: Not part of the doctrine; adherents are indifferent or split.

mixed-constitution.rationale: The ideational approach prizes the general will of the people over checks and pluralist balancing; inferred.

leader-cult.rationale: Populists favour a strong leader who voices the people, but open cult-style veneration divides adherents; inferred.

equal-parenting.rationale: Fathers' rights appeals and social-conservative family views point opposite ways; adherents split.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: Right-wing populism has no theory of class struggle; it opposes socialism and frames conflict as people versus elite, inferred.

land-redistribution.rationale: Mixed economics, but defence of property and rejection of socialist redistribution makes expropriation of estates unlikely; inferred.

refugee-return.rationale: The family opposes mass immigration and is hostile to return claims that would change the national community; inferred from nativism.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: Orbán's speech treats Hungarians across borders as one national community, and irredentism is a recurring theme; contested elsewhere.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: Social conservatives may favour religious norms but populist right parties in Europe often defend secular liberalism against Islam; split.

women-must-cover.rationale: Some defend burqa bans on cultural grounds, but compulsory covering is not part of the doctrine; adherents oppose forced religious dress.

common-currency.rationale: Euroscepticism and defence of national sovereignty are documented features, which count against shared currencies.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Cross-border national kinship appears in Orbán's rhetoric but most adherents defend existing borders; split.

national-cultural-autonomy.rationale: Nativism favours a single national culture and integration rather than parallel minority institutions; inferred.

rights-where-you-live.rationale: The doctrine is not about this question.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: The family stresses national culture, values and the popular will over economic determinism, which it does not hold.

ban-cartels.rationale: Mixed economics; adherents attack cartels as elite but also protect national champions.

no-bailouts.rationale: Populists denounce elite bailouts but often back protecting national industry; split.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: The ideational definition makes the general will paramount and treats independent bodies as obstacles to the people; Orbán's illiberal state.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: Social conservatism favours traditional gender roles, so mandated parity is opposed; inferred.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Trump's inaugural speech and the family's economic nationalism endorse protectionism, though not a closed colonial bloc.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Protectionists oppose binding standards on trade deals as foreign constraints, but some support them to block imports; inferred.

moral-incentives.rationale: The family appeals to national pride and work ethic but relies on material interests; moral incentives are a socialist idea; inferred.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: Right populism seeks power through elections, and inferred rejection of revolutionary vanguards.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Populist right-wing parties usually oppose elite privilege rhetorically but defend tradition and national order; inferred.

history-own-civilization.rationale: Nativist national-populists want schooling centred on the national heritage; Trump's address and Orbán's speech both stress national culture and identity.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Inferred from the family's nationalism and sovereigntism, which rejects foreign rule, though some adherents are hierarchical about other cultures.

patriotic-education.rationale: Pride in nation, flag and anthem is central to the nationalism of the family; Trump's address calls for total allegiance to the United States.

end-racial-preferences.rationale: Inferred from the American populist right's opposition to identity-based preferences and its stress on merit and a common national identity.

public-money-creation.rationale: Adherents are split: some distrust banks and central banks as elites, but most parties do not back public money creation.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Inferred from the mixed economic stance, which accepts capitalism and seeks to reform it nationally; collapse theory is not part of the family.

former-empire-influence.rationale: Orbán-style nationalists cultivate ties in former imperial lands, but many others, such as Trump's America First, reject foreign entanglements.

delink-world-market.rationale: Economic nationalists favour protection of home industry, but the family concerns rich-country protectionism and does not call for poor countries to delink.

labor-aristocracy.rationale: Welfare chauvinism stresses native workers' interests; the family does not use the labour-aristocracy argument and its rhetoric champions the native worker.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Typical adherents back anti-discrimination law in general while favouring cultural-conservative exceptions; libertarian populists are excluded by scope.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Populists value the general will of the people over constraints from courts and rights guarantees; Orbán's illiberal state rejects liberal checks.

colonial-treaties-void.rationale: Not a populist right issue; adherents are split.

elective-rulers.rationale: Populism claims to express the popular will, so choosing leaders by election is inferred.

minority-veto.rationale: Populism favours the will of the majority people over minority and elite constraints; inferred.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: Populists accuse corrupt elites of betraying the people, which implies a right to remove them; inferred.

parliament-supreme.rationale: Populists are not monarchists; inferred preference for elected bodies over hereditary rule.

animal-suffering-matters.rationale: Adherents are split and the ideology has no doctrine on it.

animal-use-humane.rationale: Inferred from traditionalist attitudes to farming and hunting, with humane limits.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Populists support welfare for those they deem deserving, and elites are expected to serve the people; the paternal framing is inferred.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: Populism mobilises people to take part in politics against elites; inferred.

mass-culture-pacifies.rationale: Populists say media and cultural elites serve the established order against the people; inferred.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: Populists mostly depict elites as corrupt and self-serving rather than as rulers by consent; split.

world-economy-extracts-surplus.rationale: Right populists are protectionist and anti-globalist, but do not use a surplus-transfer theory; inferred rejection of the claim as stated.

native-born-offices.rationale: Nativism is a core component, so reserving offices for native-born citizens is inferred.

party-own-road.rationale: The statement concerns communist parties; no populist right position.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: Economic nationalism and Trump's America First stress national self-sufficiency and scepticism of foreign entanglements.

return-lost-territory.rationale: Some national populists make irredentist claims, but it is not a general feature; split.

indigenous-political-leadership.rationale: Right populists defend the native majority, usually descendants of settlers in settler states; inferred.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: Adherents are split and no doctrine addresses it.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: Right populists commonly condemn communism and reject the fascist label; inferred.

slavery-not-civil-war-cause.rationale: Adherents are split, and the ideology has no doctrine on it.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: National heritage and culture are core to the ideology; inferred.

male-disadvantage-attention.rationale: Social conservatism and opposition to progressive agendas make this a common populist right claim; inferred.

domestic-violence-symmetry.rationale: Inferred from the populist right's scepticism of gender-focused programmes.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Orban's "illiberal state" speech rejects the liberal-democratic model as universal and argues for national forms.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Populists seek rule through elected leaders, not the military; inferred.

paid-care-work.rationale: Adherents are split; some favour family support, others oppose welfare expansion.

missingStatements.text: Welfare benefits should be reserved for citizens rather than extended to immigrants.
missingStatements.rationale: Welfare chauvinism, expanding welfare only for those deemed fit to receive it, is a documented feature of the family.

notes: Libertarian-leaning populists differ on markets, taxation, central banks and the state. Western European parties are more accepting of same-sex marriage and secular than Central European ones.
